CENTRAL POLICE Station.
February 1 1922

REPORT ON Interview with Mr. Metzler, Deputy Commissioner for
Russian Affairs, about control of Russians in the Settlement.

Made by D. I. Givens Forwarded by Director of Criminal Intelligence.

Sir,

In response to a request conveyed to me by Det.
Constable Korolkoff, I called on Mr. Metzler, Deputy Commission-
er for Russian Affairs on January 23. After making clear that
our conversation should be regarded as unofficial, Mr. Metzler
said that it was his opinion that no adequate steps were being
taken at present to deal with Russians in the Settlement. He
felt that the authority of the Bureau with which he was
connected was being slighted because the radical elements among
the Russians ignore its existence with impunity. He added
that, so far as he was aware, the measures taken by the police
for the control of Russians were incomplete and useless, and
that he had mentioned these matters to an official of the
Bureau of Foreign Affairs who thought it was the duty of the
Municipal Council to take the initiative in formulating plans
for the control of Russians in the Settlement. Mr. Metzler
himself was of opinion that the Bolsheviks, who consist mainly
of Jews, are very active and are responsible for the strikes
and other unrest, and strongly recommended that a special
bureau be established to deal with Russian affairs and
suggested that Mr. Troutshold, formerly Charge d'Affaires at
Bangkok, Siam, under the Tzarist Regime, be appointed to take
charge. Mr. Metzler considers that the expenses of the
bureau would not exceed $50,000.00 per annum. As an example
of the drawbacks of the present state of affairs, he pointed
out that several of the Chinese newspapers are pro-Bolshevik
and not one of them devotes any space to anti-Bolshevik

关于与俄国事务副专员梅茨勒（Metzler）先生就租界内俄国人管控问题会谈的报告。

由 D. I. Givens 撰写，经刑事情报处处长转呈。

阁下：

应科罗尔科夫（Korolkoff）警探传达给我的请求，我于1月23日拜访了俄国事务副专员梅茨勒先生。在明确我们的谈话应被视为非正式性质后，梅茨勒先生表示，他认为目前并未采取充分措施来应对租界内的俄国人。他感到，由于俄国人中的激进分子肆无忌惮地无视其存在，他所隶属的机构的权威正受到轻视。他补充说，据他所知，警方为管控俄国人所采取的措施既不完整也无实效，他曾向外交部的一位官员提及此事，该官员认为，制定管控租界内俄国人的计划是工部局的职责所在，应由工部局主动发起。梅茨勒先生本人认为，主要由犹太人组成的布尔什维克非常活跃，是罢工和其他动荡事件的罪魁祸首，并强烈建议设立一个专门机构来处理俄国事务，还建议任命前沙皇政权时期驻暹罗曼谷的代办特劳特肖尔德（Troutshold）先生负责此事。梅茨勒认为，该机构的经费每年不超过50,000.00美元。作为当前局势弊端的一个例子，他指出几家中文报纸亲布尔什维克，且没有一家刊登任何反布尔什维克的

February 1 192 2

REPORT ON Non-descript Foreign Criminal Elements

Made by D. I. Givens Forwarded by

Sir,

The large increase within recent years in the non-descript foreign population of Shanghai, the majority of whom do not enjoy the privileges of extraterritoriality, has created a situation which could not have been foreseen at the time the Settlement came into existence, and has evolved a serious problem for the police. The lawless section amongst this class of persons constitutes a public danger, but the political extremists are potentially a still greater menace. The necessity of police surveillance over these elements has been recognized and in this connection the licensing of foreign boarding houses has had a good effect. With a view to still further strengthen the hands of the police in dealing with this problem, I beg to make the following recommendations :-

1.- That an arrangement be come to with the Consular Body and Chinese Authorities whereby foreigners of non-treaty powers staying or residing in Shanghai would be required within 48 hours of their arrival in Shanghai to register with the police, giving their names, nationalities, occupations, addresses and places of employment.

2.- That when such foreigners are about to leave the Settlement, they must supply the police with the date of their intended departure and their destination.

3.- That foreigners deported from outports or neighbouring countries be not permitted to reside in Shanghai.

Regulations of this description have, I understand, been enforced for some time in Singapore and The Netherlands

关于身份不明的外国犯罪分子的报告

由 D. I. Givens 撰写，经________________转呈

阁下：

近年来，上海身份不明的外国人口大幅增加，其中大多数人不享有治外法权特权，这造成了一种在租界成立之时无法预见的局面，并给警方带来了一个严重的问题。这类人中的不法之徒构成了公共危险，但政治极端分子潜在的危害更大。警方已认识到对这些分子进行监视的必要性，在此方面，对外国寄宿舍实行执照管理已取得了良好效果。为了进一步加强警方处理这一问题的能力，谨提出以下建议：

1.- 与领事团和中国当局达成协议，要求在上海停留或居住的非条约国外国人在抵达上海后48小时内向警方登记，提供姓名、国籍、职业、地址和工作地点。

2.- 当此类外国人即将离开租界时，必须向警方提供其预定离境日期和目的地。

3.- 不允许被从通商口岸或邻国驱逐的外国人在上海居住。

据我了解，此类规定在新加坡和荷属
